mapper.select: SELECT id, name AS leaveTypeName, total_days AS totalDays FROM leave_type;

select lr.start_date,lr.end_date,lr.reason,lr.status,d.name as department_Name,li.image as images from leave_request lr join employee e on e.id = lr.employee_id join department d on d.id= e.department_id left join leave_image li on li.leave_request_id= lr.id where employee_id=#{id}

select lr.id as leaveRequestId,lt.name as leaveType,lr.start_date,lr.end_date,lr.reason,lr.status,d.name as departmentName,e.name as employeeName,li.image as images from leave_request lr join employee e on e.id = lr.employee_id join department d on d.id= e.department_id join leave_type lt on lt.id= lr.leave_type_id left join leave_image li on li.leave_request_id= lr.id
mapper.update: update leave_request set status = "APPROVED" where id = #{leaveRequestId}
